text:
Four satellite sensor families were checked for fire detections on ASSET-F03, using NASA FIRMS near-real-time data:

- VIIRS on Suomi NPP (S-NPP)
- VIIRS on NOAA-20
- VIIRS on NOAA-21
- MODIS

The review period was 4 October to 3 November 2026. Each sensor is reported as covered for the full period. For S-NPP, coverage comes as two consecutive segments (4 Oct–2 Nov and 2 Nov–3 Nov) that together span the whole period.

None of the sensors returned a detection intersecting the asset (0 detections). Because every sensor covered every day, this reflects a clean record across the checked sensors rather than a data gap.

One caveat: the asset's area isn't recorded in the run metadata, so I can't comment on how large the footprint checked was.
